title: feat(nm2slpx): forall-orthogonal M vs O at t+1 on two-axis same-lock x-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Two-axis same-lock seed, x-probes, forall-orthogonal: forall-perp HOLDs at all four probes while axis-cover FAILs at A and D (union misses e_2) and every exist-opposite variant (M reverse, O reverse, M face, O face) also fails. Confirms on a second seed the #7299 finding that forall-perp survives where cover dies.
